sections.text:
Note
The following extract is from a larger consulting project.
The app was one part of the project.

A project for only the app would involve a shorter methodology as follows:

A probe of the communication artefacts, a small insight exercise into the current adopters of the app to understand the context, adoption and continued usability insights: perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use and attitude towards app and brand. The STEPPS* framework for virality will be used.
*Jonah Berger, 2013.

STEPPS* Framework

Social Currency: People share things that make them look good or exclusive.

Triggers: External cues prompt people to talk about certain topics.

Emotion: Strong emotions, positive or negative, make content more shareable.

Public: Observable behaviors encourage others to imitate.

Practical Value: Useful information gets shared to help others.

Stories: Relatable narratives stick and are easily shared.
*Jonah Berger, 2013.
